explanation: Undervoltage below 0.70 pu necessitates tripping within 2.0 seconds to avoid system instability.
Voltage within this range for OV1 requires coordination with clearing time settings.
Voltage below this threshold for UV1 requires coordination with clearing time settings.
Voltage below this threshold for UV2 requires coordination with clearing time settings.
Category III OV1 settings require coordination with extended clearing time ranges.
DERs in Category III must ride through voltage dips below 0.5 pu during momentary cessation mode.

condition: frequency_hz > 66.0 OR frequency_hz < 61.0 OR clearing_time_sec > 1000.0 OR clearing_time_sec < 180.0
explanation: DER must trip when frequency or clearing time exceeds specified thresholds to prevent instability.
DERs must not trip during frequency excursions with ROCOF less than or equal to specified thresholds (0.5, 2.0, 3.0 Hz/s for Categories I, II, III) to maintain grid stability.
DER must continue dynamic voltage support and restore active current within 0.4s if voltage is below lower continuous operation region
DER must discontinue dynamic voltage support and resume reactive power functionality after 5s when voltage surpasses lower continuous operation region
Proportional reduction of active power above a frequency threshold helps support BPS frequency control during abnormal conditions.
Frequency droop values must not be set below 0.03 or above 0.05 to maintain proper power sharing.
Frequency droop values must not be set below 0.03 or above 0.05 to maintain proper power sharing.
Open-loop response time must remain within 0.2 to 10 seconds to ensure timely frequency response.
Multi-phase DER must remain operational during phase angle changes within specified thresholds to maintain grid stability.
Clearing time for UI prevention may be extended up to five seconds with mutual agreement between the area EPS operator and the DER owner.
